title: Compute Jacobian syzygies of a singular line arrangement

source.citation: Alexandru Dimca and Gabriel Sticlaru, Syzygies of Jacobian ideals and weighted homogeneous singularities, arXiv:1407.0168

translation.notes: The Singular computation is translated to a graded polynomial-module map. Its exact kernel has minimal coordinate degrees two and three, giving the reported four-dimensional degree-three component.
